summary: Prove Poisson shared-store execution and order-independent plane publication

examined.reason: Extended the local instruction contract through actual shared stores, allocation geometry, complete order-independent plane publication and snapshot operand reads. Repeated-barrier control and visibility remain explicit unfinished work.
Parent records the shared-store and publication proofs without claiming a complete concurrent cell kernel.

The explicit dependency audit expands to cover every new public declaration. Standard-axiom-only acceptance and the separate source-fidelity, textual-binding, compiler and GPU boundaries remain unchanged.
The reference solver, represented equations, residual certificate and empirical backend behavior are unchanged. This is an additional partial instruction proof.

results.method: Full pinned integration check; Python hardware tests; fresh saved-PTX binding checks; source-semantic review; Stratic and distribution validation
results.environment: Lean 4.34.0 and pinned TorchLean/FloatLib dependency set; local Python3; existing saved GPU artifacts, no new GPU execution or external model call
results.evidence: integration/torchlean/check.sh passed 2900 exact dependency reports with standard Lean axioms only; 25 Python hardware tests passed; fresh binding receipt checked 720 contraction blocks and 630 shared-store blocks across 30 layouts, including adjacency of four contraction/store pairs; residual receipt rechecked all 30 layouts. New local store/publication proof endpoints independently audited; pinned PTX 9.4 st/bar review and SHA256 verified. Description links valid. README unchanged. Initial snapshot d5936011896c761d4a7cec01cdcbab4ee124dbfc; final changes after proof check are guide clarification, hardware binding adjacency checks (retested) and generated receipts. Integration sources remained unchanged during the full check. Full barrier control/visibility remains explicitly unproved.
